character: Technical 4.657km, 14-turn Grand Prix circuit without the final chicane. High-speed right-handers load the left-side tires; the final two right-handers lead directly onto the start/finish straight.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.technique: Control entry speed for the right-left opening sequence. A stable exit sets up T2 and T3
corners.trap: Getting on the kerb too aggressively into the right-left sequence

corners.name: Turn 3
corners.technique: Carry momentum from T1-T2, smooth exit leads to T4
corners.trap: Over-driving T1 entry compromises the entire opening complex

corners.name: Turn 4
corners.technique: Early apex and slowest point, speed reduction early in the corner
corners.trap: Going deep on entry compromises the exit and preparation for T5

corners.name: Turn 5
corners.technique: Control entry speed on the downhill approach and apply throttle progressively on exit
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed into T5 and running wide on exit

corners.name: Turn 7
corners.type: uphill left into right at T8
corners.technique: Use camber for grip and stay smooth through the direction change. Prepare the exit for T8-T9
corners.trap: Snap oversteer on throttle application at T7 apex

corners.name: Turn 9
corners.technique: Critical corner — exit speed feeds the back straight. Late apex, progressive throttle
corners.trap: Compromising T9 exit by over-driving T7-T8

corners.name: Turn 10
corners.technique: Finish the main braking phase before committing to the left-hand turn and keep the car balanced into T11
corners.trap: Locking up on entry or using too much exit width before T11

corners.name: Turn 14
corners.type: fast right-hander onto the start/finish straight
corners.technique: Prioritise exit speed onto the start/finish straight. Keep steering inputs smooth and use the available exit width
corners.trap: Running wide on exit or carrying an unstable car out of T13
